'''Anders''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]] Anders and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Pell (Nautolan)|Pell]] were shot down by Imperial forces and Anders was killed in the crash.
